jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
As a Software Engineer, you will contribute to GE Vernova Grid Software's mission of enabling a more sustainable and reliable energy future by developing and enhancing software solutions that support critical power system operations worldwide. This role combines software engineering fundamentals with power systems knowledge, requiring hands\-on experience in developing and maintaining enterprise applications using technologies such as C\+\+ and Java, while gaining exposure to modern full\-stack and cloud\-based architectures. You will collaborate with senior engineers, architects, product managers, and domain experts to translate utility and grid operation requirements into high\-quality software solutions. The ideal candidate will possess strong programming and analytical skills, a solid understanding of algorithms and data structures, and a passion for delivering reliable, scalable, and maintainable software. This role provides an opportunity to work on innovative Grid Software products that help transform the future of energy.
**Job Description**
===================


**Responsibilities**
--------------------


* Design, develop, test, and maintain software components and applications for Grid Software and power system solutions.
* Develop features using **C\+\+, Java, and modern software development technologies** while adhering to engineering best practices.
* Participate in code refactoring and modernization initiatives to improve maintainability, performance, and scalability.
* Collaborate with senior engineers, architects, and domain experts to understand requirements and deliver high\-quality solutions.
* Translate power systems and utility business requirements into efficient and reliable software implementations.
* Develop and implement algorithms, data structures, and analytical functions within product modules.
* Contribute to software design, code reviews, unit testing, and debugging activities.
* Apply Agile development practices, CI/CD, automated testing, security, and quality standards throughout the development lifecycle.
* Analyze and troubleshoot application performance, defects, and production issues.
* Work closely with cross\-functional teams to deliver software features on time and with high quality.

**Desired Characteristics**
---------------------------


* Strong programming skills in **C\+\+ and/or Java** with a solid foundation in software engineering principles.
* Experience working with enterprise software products and complex codebases.
* Understanding of software refactoring, code quality improvement, and maintainable design practices.
* Familiarity with modern full\-stack technologies, REST APIs, databases, and web application development.
* Strong understanding of object\-oriented design, data structures, algorithms, and software design patterns.
* Knowledge of Linux and Windows development environments.
* Understanding of power systems, energy management, grid applications, or utility operations is highly desirable.
* Ability to learn and apply domain knowledge to develop effective software solutions.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and debugging skills.
* Excellent communication, teamwork, and collaboration skills.

**Qualifications**
------------------


* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Power Systems Engineering, or a related STEM discipline.
* 2\-5 years of experience in software development or software product engineering.
* Hands\-on experience developing software using **C\+\+, Java, or similar object\-oriented programming languages**.
* Experience working through the full software development lifecycle, including design, development, testing, and support.
* Familiarity with Agile development methodologies and source control tools.
* Exposure to software modernization, code maintenance, and debugging activities.
* Knowledge of databases, APIs, and distributed application development.
* Understanding of cloud technologies, microservices, or modern web frameworks is a plus.
* Exposure to power systems, utilities, industrial control systems, EMS, DMS, SCADA, or related domains is preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to learn quickly, work independently, and contribute effectively within a collaborative engineering team.
**Additional Information**
==========================


**Relocation Assistance Provided:** Yes

jobs.title: Senior Data Product Analyst – Data Distribution & Data Share Capabilities
jobs.description:
**Where Ambition Meets Innovation**

  

At LPL’s Global Capability Center, you'll find a collaborative culture where your voice matters, integrity guides every decision, and technology fuels progress. Your skills, talents, and ideas will redefine what's possible. LPL's success reflects its exceptional employees, who together pursue one noble purpose: empowering financial advisors to deliver personalized advice for all who need it. We’re proud to be expanding and reaching new heights in Hyderabad.

  

Join us as we create something extraordinary together.

**Job Overview:**


LPL Financial is seeking a Data Product Analyst to support our Data Distribution and Platform capabilities, with a strong focus on how data is produced, shaped, governed, and delivered to downstream consumers across the firm. This role sits at the intersection of Product Management, Data Product Ownership, and Advanced Analysis, and is designed for a senior individual contributor who can bring rigor and clarity to complex, data\-centric platform initiatives.


The Data Product Analyst focuses on data as a product—helping define data contracts, validate quality, assess downstream impact, and support product and platform decisions related to data distribution via feeds, APIs, and shared platforms. The ideal candidate is comfortable working across upstream systems of record, platform services, and downstream consumers, and excels at turning complex data flows into actionable insights and decisions.

**Responsibilities:**


Data Distribution \& Platform Enablement

* Partner with Product Managers and Platform Capability Owners to support data distribution strategy, including feeds and shared data services.
* Help define and refine data products that serve multiple downstream consumers (internal teams, platforms, partners).
* Analyze data usage patterns, dependencies, and downstream impacts to inform platform and roadmap decisions.
* Support decisions around standardization vs. specialization in data distribution models.


Product Discovery \& Capability Support

* Support product discovery by helping translate business and platform needs into clear data‑centric problem statements.
* Contribute to roadmap planning by evaluating value, risk, and complexity across data distribution initiatives.
* Help define outcomes and success measures for data platform capabilities (e.g., usability, reliability, adoption, quality).

Advanced Data Analysis \& Problem Solving

* Perform hands‑on exploratory and diagnostic analysis across distributed data sources and platforms.
* Investigate data quality issues, lineage gaps, and semantic inconsistencies that affect downstream consumers.
* Conduct impact analysis for schema changes, new feeds, platform migrations, or system decommissions.
* Identify systemic issues in data flow, transformation, or consumption and recommend durable solutions.

Data Product Ownership (Supporting / Platform‑Level)

* Support Data Product Owners by helping define:
* Data contracts, schemas, and semantic definitions
* Data quality rules, validation logic, and controls
* Usage expectations and downstream dependencies
* Maintain traceability between business intent, data products, and technical implementation.
* Partner with engineering, architecture, and data platform teams to support scalable, reusable distribution patterns.

Agile Execution \& Delivery

* Contribute to Jira artifacts (features, stories, acceptance criteria) with strong data and platform context.
* Participate in backlog refinement, sprint planning, and demos to ensure work reflects validated platform and consumer needs.
* Support prioritization decisions by providing evidence‑based impact and dependency analysis.

Stakeholder Communication \& Influence

* Act as an analytical partner to Product Managers, Platform Owners, Engineering, and downstream consumer teams.
* Communicate complex data flow and platform concepts in clear, decision‑ready narratives.
* Help align stakeholders across domains by grounding conversations in data realities and trade‑offs.
**What are we looking for?**


We’re looking for strong collaborators who deliver exceptional client experiences and thrive in fast\-paced, team\-oriented environments. Our ideal candidates **pursue greatness**, **act with integrity**, and are **driven to help our clients succeed**. We value those who embrace creativity, continuous improvement, and contribute to a culture where we **win together** and **create and share joy** in our work.

**Requirements:**

* 8\+ years of experience in Product Analytics, Data Analysis, Data Product Ownership, or Platform‑oriented Product roles.
* Strong hands‑on experience with SQL (advanced querying, joins, performance awareness)
* Experience working with data platforms, distributed data systems, or integration layers.
* Experience adopting emerging AI‑enabled capabilities to improve the speed, depth, and effectiveness of data analysis
* Experience operating in Agile/Scrum environments with cross‑functional product and engineering teams.
* Proven ability to work across ambiguity and translate complex data ecosystems into actionable insights.
* Solid understanding of:
* Data modeling and semantic consistency
* Data quality, lineage, and governance concepts
* Data feeds, pipelines, and event‑driven architectures (conceptual and analytical understanding)

**Preferences:**

* Experience supporting data distribution platforms, advisor data platforms, or shared enterprise data services.
* Background in financial services, wealth management, or other highly regulated data environments.
**Core Competencies****:**

* Familiarity with downstream consumer needs (applications, analytics platforms, partners, regulatory consumers).
* Experience performing impact analysis for data changes across multiple consuming systems.

jobs.description:
**Job Details**
---------------


Location:
Hyderabad, Telangāna, IN
Category:
Agile
Employment Type:
Full time
Job Ref:
R2626319\-333
IND Staff Project Manager \- GCC075
We’re determined to make a difference and are proud to be an insurance company that goes well beyond coverages and policies. Working here means having every opportunity to achieve your goals – and to help others accomplish theirs, too. Join our team as we help shape the future.

**Job Summary**


The IT Resiliency Product Owner is responsible for defining, prioritizing, and driving the delivery of enterprise resiliency and recovery capabilities across The Hartford’s technology landscape. This role serves as the bridge between business objectives, technology teams, and resiliency strategy ensuring critical services can withstand, respond to, and rapidly recover from disruptive events including cyber incidents, infrastructure failures, and data center outages.


This role owns the resiliency product vision and roadmap, with a focus on disaster recovery (DR), cyber recovery (CR), resiliency, and AI/ automation at scale. The Product Owner partners with governance, engineering, cyber, risk, and business stakeholders to deliver capabilities that are measurable, testable, and audit\-ready aligned with enterprise standards and regulatory expectations.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Product Strategy \& Roadmap**

* Define and own the enterprise resiliency product strategy, roadmap, and backlog aligned to recovery priorities and risk posture.
* Translate resiliency objectives (e.g., Foundation Services (Tier\-0\) readiness, RTC/RTO/RPO adherence, cyber recovery) into prioritized deliverables and measurable outcomes.
* Align product roadmap with enterprise transformation initiatives (cloud adoption, hybrid landscape, disaster recovery/ cyber resilience maturity).

**Delivery Execution \& Agile Product Ownership**

* Act as Product Owner for resiliency platforms and capabilities (e.g., DR orchestration, recovery automation, IRE, validation frameworks).
* Manage and prioritize backlog, user stories, and acceptance criteria for governance and engineering.
* Partner with engineering leads to ensuring timely, high\-quality delivery of features and enhancements.
* Drive sprint planning, backlog refinement, and product demos with clear success criteria.

**Resiliency \& Recovery Capabilities**

* Lead development of enterprise capabilities including:
	+ Disaster Recovery and Cyber Recovery orchestration
	+ Automated recovery runbooks and validation frameworks
	+ Isolated Recovery Environment (IRE) capabilities
	+ Foundation Services (Tier\-0\) and critical application resiliency onboarding
* Ensure capabilities are designed for scalability, repeatability, and auditability (evidence\-based validation).

**Stakeholder Engagement \& Governance**

* Partner with Technology, Cybersecurity, Risk, Compliance, and Business stakeholders to define requirements and ensure alignment.
* Support the Governance team by coordinating resiliency standards, maintaining policies and procedures, tracking compliance requirements, and driving follow\-up on identified gaps and action items.
* Provide executive\-level reporting on product progress, risk posture, and resiliency maturity.
* Define and track OKRs (e.g., recovery success rates, automation coverage, validation completion, audit findings).

**Innovation \& Automation**

* Drive adoption of automation, AI/GenAI, and analytics in resiliency and recovery processes.
* Identify opportunities to reduce manual effort and improve speed, consistency, and reliability of recovery execution.
* Enable self\-service and productized recovery capabilities for application teams.

**Required Skills \& Qualifications**

**Required Qualifications**

* 5–8\+ years of experience in IT, with a focus on Product Ownership, Resiliency, Disaster Recovery (DR), Cyber Recovery (CR), or related domains.
* Proven experience operating as a Product Owner in an Agile environment (Scrum/Kanban), including backlog management and stakeholder alignment.
* Strong understanding of resiliency concepts:
	+ Disaster Recovery (DR), Business Continuity (BCP), Cyber Recovery
	+ RTO/RPO, failover/failback, recovery orchestration
* Demonstrated ability to translate business risk and requirements into technical capabilities.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to engage both technical teams and executive stakeholders.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with enterprise resiliency tools/platforms (e.g., Rally, ServiceNow, BCM tools, orchestration platforms).
* Experience supporting regulatory, audit, or compliance requirements in financial services.
* Familiarity with frameworks such as NIST CSF, ISO 22301, or similar resiliency standards.
* Experience with automation, scripting, or AI/GenAI\-enabled workflows in operational environments.
* Certification(s) such as Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO), AWS/Azure certifications, or DR/BCP certifications.

**Key Competencies**

* Strategic thinking and product mindset
* Risk\-based decision making
* Data\-driven and outcome\-oriented execution
* Strong collaboration and stakeholder influence
* Continuous improvement and innovation focus

**Success Measures**

* Increased automation and standardization of recovery processes
* Improved recovery validation rates and audit readiness
* Reduction in recovery time and operational risk exposure
* Adoption of resiliency products across foundation servers (Tier\-0\) / critical applications


Measurable improvements in cyber and disaster recovery prepared

Principal Payments Product Manager
 



  





**About Us** 




  





 HighRadius provides a single Agentic AI platform for the Office of the CFO. It integrates 180\+ agents that orchestrate end\-to\-end processes across
 
 Order\-to\-Cash
 
 ,
 
 Close \& Reconciliation, Consolidation \& Reporting
 
 ,
 
 Accounts Payable
 
 ,
 
 B2B Payments
 
 , and
 
 Treasury
 
 . HighRadius guarantees operational KPI improvements by mapping them to specific agents on the platform. With a 3\-6 month go\-live period, HighRadius drives value creation at 1300\+ enterprises such as 3M, Unilever, Bristol\-Myers Squibb Company, Red Bull, Lufthansa, and
 
 more
 
 . HighRadius has been consistently recognised as a
 
 market leader
 
 by Gartner, IDC, and Forrester.
 



  





**Job Summary** 




  





 As a
 **Principal Product Manager** 
 at HighRadius, you will own the end\-to\-end strategic vision, roadmap, and execution for our next\-generation B2B merchant card processing infrastructure and ACH networks. You will drive the convergence of traditional business payments with enterprise AI automation, enabling Global 2000 clients to optimize transactional cash flow, structurally lower transaction costs, and unify global payment channels.
 



  





 This high\-impact, individual contributor (IC) leadership role demands a rigorous synthesis of technical payment gateway infrastructure architecture, hands\-on data analytics, and high\-stakes stakeholder management. You will serve as the premier payment architect bridging commercial sales opportunities, complex consulting deployment cycles, and deep platform engineering teams.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**1\. Payment Domain Expertise \& Cost Analytics** 




  




* **Payment SME Leadership:** 
 Act as the definitive enterprise Subject Matter Expert on global B2B infrastructure, covering payment gateways, merchant acquiring, merchant card\-not\-present (CNP) flows, and clearing rails (ACH, FedNow, SEPA, Real\-Time Payments).
* **Processing Cost Optimization:** 
 Conduct exhaustive quantitative analysis of payment processing costs, interchange brackets, and card scheme rules to design platform routing capabilities (e.g., Level 2/3 processing data enrichment) that dramatically compress client acceptance fees.
* **Data Analytics \& Prototyping:** 
 Write standalone data\-analysis scripts and build functional data use cases (utilizing SQL or Python/scripting logic) to surface macro transaction trends, troubleshoot routing anomalies, and validate infrastructure optimization.



  





**2\. B2B Client Solutioning \& GTM Enablement** 




  




* **Best\-in\-Class Strategy Definition:** 
 Lead the definition of a best\-in\-class payments strategy for individual clients to maximize processing outcomes, reduce friction, and align with their unique operational goals.
* **Solution Design:** 
 Architect end\-to\-end payment topologies, specialized multi\-entity settlement configurations, and complex reconciliation workflows tailored for massive corporate ecosystems, considering HighRadius products.
* **High\-Impact Demonstrations:** 
 Design and deliver sophisticated, technically precise gateway capability demos that clearly articulate architectural advantages and business value to corporate C\-suites (CFOs, CIOs, Treasurers).
* **Cross\-Functional Support Operations:** 
 Serve as the primary product pillar reinforcing Sales (accelerating pre\-sales technical validation), Consulting (authoring deployment blueprints), and Support (providing tier\-3 infrastructure escalation resolution).



  





**3\. Stakeholder Management \& Ecosystem Relations** 




  




* **Direct Client Feedback Loops:** 
 Organically lead client\-facing feedback sessions and technical discovery panels, transforming disparate merchant pain points into clear, prioritized engineering deliverables.
* **Payment Partner Management:** 
 Cultivate and negotiate strategic partnerships with card networks, payment processors, acquiring banks, and regional Alternative Payment Method (APM) institutions to optimize unit economics and platform breadth.
* **Internal Stakeholder Alignment:** 
 Masterfully manage expectations and unify priorities across competing commercial timelines, consulting delivery boundaries, and engineering constraints.
* **Defining the "Contract":** 
 Maintain precise technical interfaces (API field mappings and schema definitions) as a source of truth for payment partners, ensuring alignment between engineering teams and network expectations
* **Evidence\-Based Alignment:** 
 Utilize functional specifications as objective documentation during escalations or negotiations to shift discussions from subjective friction to evidence\-based technical root\-cause resolution.



  





**4\. Gateway Architecture \& Growth Strategy** 




  




* **Product Gateway Strategy:** 
 Drive the structural, API\-first strategy for HighRadius's processing engine, maintaining rigid PCI\-DSS compliance, minimal latency, and robust multi\-acquirer failover rules.
* **Processor Agnostic Strategy:** 
 Architect a flexible, processor\-agnostic processing model that enables seamless interoperability across various payment gateways and acquirers, ensuring platform flexibility and reducing vendor dependency.
* **Product\-Led Growth (PLG):** 
 Design and execute product adoption loops aimed at maximizing Gross Transaction Volume (GTV), capturing broader wallet share from existing platforms, and lowering user friction.



  





**5\. Mentorship \& Junior PM Development** 




  




* **Outcome\-Oriented Goal Setting:** 
 Guide junior PMs in translating high\-level business objectives into measurable OKRs. Mentor them to focus on impact (e.g., TCA reduction, GTV growth) rather than just output, ensuring every roadmap item has a clear business case.
* **Mastering the Specification Craft:** 
 Mentor junior PMs to treat functional specifications as living 'contracts'—not just…

jobs.title: Product Manager, Specialist
jobs.description:
**About Vanguard**
 Founded in 1975, Vanguard is one of the world's leading investment management companies. The firm offers investments, advice, and retirement services to tens of millions of individual investors around the globe—directly, through workplace plans, and through financial intermediaries.
   

  

******Vanguard’s India Office******
 Vanguard’s office in India is a significant milestone in our global expansion. We are committed to establishing an enduring technology center in Hyderabad, Telangana and are excited to be adding talent who will focus on Artificial Intelligence (AI), mobile, and cloud\-based technologies that drive our business outcomes and deliver a world\-class experience for our clients.
   

  

**Role Summary**
 This role leads the strategic vision and roadmap for a digital product, demonstrating an understanding of the digital product(s) and associated business areas. Digital products often have divisional implications. This role also integrates market trends and consumer insights to drive product innovation and inform future enhancements.
   

  

**Responsibilites**
* Provides digital product management services on a digital product, applying functional expertise to improve digital product results.
* Collaborates with small cross\-functional teams to demonstrate best practices that drive significant change to the client experience.
* Coaches digital product teams towards best practices and learnings. Ensures delivery of messaging, communication, and customer outreach as necessary.
* Partners with stakeholders to resolve production and implementation issues in a timely manner, and supports/drives escalations where required to enable rapid delivery.
* Leads the planning, development and implementation of a new digital product. Defines and analyzes markets, developing detailed product features and requirements, and developing implementation plans.
* Employs a variety of qualitative and quantitative analysis techniques to continually improve the user experience.
* Participates in and provides recommendations for ongoing business planning and departmental prioritization activities.
* Participates in special projects and performs other duties as assigned.
* Manages the entire product lifecycle from planning to execution, ensuring alignment with organizational goals.
* Researches market conditions and identifies emerging consumer trends to guide product innovation and enhancement opportunities.
* Collaborates with cross\-functional teams to define and oversee the development of product features and functionality.
* Prepares product documentation and supports marketing and sales with product knowledge and technical expertise.
* Leverages customer and market feedback to assess product performance and inform future roadmap decisions.


**Qualifications And Skills**
* Minimum 5 years of product management or related work experience; two years of project management preferred. Experience in financial services or function\-specific domains is an advantage.
* Bachelor’s degree (B.E./B.Tech/B.Sc./BBA) in Business, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field is required.
* Good to have skills in digital product lifecycle management, stakeholder collaboration, customer journey optimization, market and trend analysis, and cross\-functional coordination.
* Familiarity with product development tools and agile methodologies is desirable.
* Platform skills in digital technologies, data analytics tools, and customer engagement platforms are beneficial.
* Strong written and verbal communication, problem\-solving, time management, and analytical skills are essential.
* Certifications such as Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO), SAFe Product Owner/Product Manager, or Pragmatic Product Management are preferred.


******Location******
 This role is based in Hyderabad, Telangana at Vanguard’s India office. Only qualified external applicants will be considered.
   

  

******Our mission******
 Vanguard adheres to a simple purpose: To take a stand for all investors, to treat them fairly, and to give them the best chance for investment success.
   

  

******Our commitment to you******
**Benefits**
 Vanguard takes the same long\-term view of your success—at work and in life—with Benefits and Rewards packages that reflect what you care about, throughout all the phases and stages of your life. Our Total Rewards programs provide you and your loved ones with wellness support for key areas in your life:
   

  

******Financial wellness******
 We're committed to enabling your financial success and provide competitive offers and programs.
   

  

******Physical wellness******
 We're committed to providing benefits that support your physical health and wellness.
   

  

******Personal wellness******
 We're committed to providing resources that help support the full scope of your life.
   

  

******How we work******
 Vanguard has implemented a hybrid working model for most of our employees (crew members), designed to capture the benefits of enhanced flexibility while enabling in\-person learning, collaboration, and connection. We believe our mission\-driven and highly collaborative culture is a critical enabler to support long\-term client outcomes and enrich the employee experience.

 The Org Excellence (OE) team within RBS Business Excellence is seeking a Senior Product Manager (Non\-Tech) to own the product vision, strategy, and cross\-functional delivery of scalable AI\-aided solutions that serve Business Excellence programs and are designed for reuse across Amazon.
   

  

 This role combines product strategy with AI fluency and cross\-organisational delivery — owning the end\-to\-end customer experience of complex, multi\-stakeholder programs that turn OE’s operational expertise into productised, self\-service tooling. You will own a portfolio of 5 AI\-aided solutions, define the roadmap, drive customer adoption, and partner with RBS Tech for engineering execution — without managing a dedicated engineering team.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Own end\-to\-end product vision, strategy, and roadmap for AI\-aided OE solutions (PEX AI Career Coach, CI Platform, AI Agent Knowledge Management, Unified Innovation Platform)
* Define and prioritise features by working backward from customer needs; write product requirements (BRDs/PRFAQs) that are clear, actionable, and measurable
* Partner with RBS Tech (AI architecture \& engineering) to translate product vision into delivered solutions leveraging existing funded engineering teams
* Drive cross\-org adoption strategy — identify early adopters, run pilots, measure outcomes, and scale solutions to other Amazon orgs (Ops, CS, AWS)
* Conduct user research, competitive benchmarking, and data analysis to identify opportunities and validate product\-market fit for internal AI tools
* Build POCs and prototypes using AI tools directly (agentic workflows, prompt engineering, no\-code/low\-code) to de\-risk ideas before committing engineering resources
* Establish success metrics (adoption, NPS, time\-saved, cost\-avoidance) and reporting mechanisms; present progress in MBRs/QBRs with data\-driven narratives
* Own agent governance policy — define reuse standards, lifecycle management rules, and discovery mechanisms for AI agents across RBS
* Influence strategic direction across Business Excellence, working with senior leadership to align product investments with organizational priorities
* Manage stakeholder relationships across multiple BUs, balancing competing priorities while maintaining a coherent product strategy

* 5\+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience

* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
* Experience with end to end product delivery
* Experience as a product manager or owner
* Experience owning technology products

**About Us**
 Zelis is modernizing the healthcare financial experience in the United States (U.S.) across payers, providers, and healthcare consumers. We serve more than 750 payers, including the top five national health plans, regional health plans, TPAs and millions of healthcare providers and consumers across our platform of solutions. Zelis sees across the system to identify, optimize, and solve problems holistically with technology built by healthcare experts – driving real, measurable results for clients.
   

  

 At Zelis, AI is woven into the fabric of how we work. Every associate is expected \- and empowered \- to partner with AI to challenge the status quo, accelerate innovation, and amplify their impact. This is a place for builders with a growth mindset who act with agility, embrace change, and use modern technology to shape smarter solutions, exceptional experiences, and the future of our industry for our clients, customers, and our culture.
   

  

**Why We Do What We Do**
 In the U.S., consumers, payers, and providers face significant challenges throughout the healthcare financial journey. Zelis helps streamline the process by offering solutions that improve transparency, efficiency, and communication among all parties involved. By addressing the obstacles that patients face in accessing care, navigating the intricacies of insurance claims, and the logistical challenges healthcare providers encounter with processing payments, Zelis aims to create a more seamless and effective healthcare financial system.
   

  

 Zelis India plays a crucial role in this mission by supporting various initiatives that enhance the healthcare financial experience. The local team contributes to the development and implementation of innovative solutions, ensuring that technology and processes are optimized for efficiency and effectiveness. Beyond operational expertise, Zelis India cultivates a collaborative work culture, leadership development, and global exposure, creating a dynamic environment for professional growth. With hybrid work flexibility, comprehensive healthcare benefits, financial wellness programs, and cultural celebrations, we foster a holistic workplace experience. Additionally, the team plays a vital role in maintaining high standards of service delivery and contributes to Zelis’ award\-winning culture.

jobs.description:
We are Progress (Nasdaq: PRGS) \- the trusted provider of software that enables our customers to develop, deploy and manage responsible, AI\-powered applications and experience with agility and ease.


We’re proud to have a diverse, global team where we value the individual and enrich our culture by considering varied perspectives because we believe people power progress. Join us as a **HRIS Specialist, Senior Principal** and help us do what we do best: propelling business forward. Learn More about **us**


We are hiring an experienced Workday Technical and Functional Consultant to act as the single point of contact between our HR, Finance, IT and business stakeholders and the Workday delivery team. This is a hands\-on configuration role, not a program management role: the successful candidate will have spent the last 10 years working inside Workday tenants, configuring solutions, building and troubleshooting integrations, and producing reporting that leaders actually use.


The role sits at the center of demand and delivery. Requests arrive from many directions and in many forms, from a one\-line question about an eligibility rule to a multi\-quarter programme of work. This person translates those requests into clear problem statements, sizes them honestly, and then distributes the work across the full delivery group, which spans our internal HRIS team members and our Workday consultant. Part of that judgement is deciding at the point of intake which items should sit with the consultant from the start rather than being picked up internally and handed over later. Equally important is the ability to explain the resulting design back to the requesting team in plain business language, and to the delivery group in configuration terms.

**In This role, you will :**

**Stakeholder Engagement and Requirement Intake**

* Serve as the single point of contact for all stakeholder groups raising Workday demand, running a consistent intake process rather than an ad hoc queue.
* Gather, challenge and document requirements from HR, Payroll, Finance, IT and business leaders, converting loosely worded asks into precise, testable problem statements.
* Translate business problem statements into functional and technical design for the team, and translate proposed Workday solutions back into language the requesting team can validate and sign off.
* Maintain a single prioritized demand backlog, agree sequencing with stakeholders, and communicate trade\-offs when capacity is constrained.
* Run design walkthroughs, impact assessments and readiness sessions ahead of each Workday release.

**Configuration and Solution Design**

* Own end\-to\-end configuration design across the Workday footprint, working hands\-on in the tenant rather than directing others from a distance.
* Configure and troubleshoot business processes, condition rules, security groups, domain and business process security policies, calculated fields and eligibility rules.
* Assess downstream impact of every change across modules before it is built, and protect tenant hygiene through disciplined use of sandbox, sandbox preview and production migration practices.
* Define and enforce configuration standards, naming conventions, testing expectations and documentation for the team.

**Integrations and Reporting**

* Design, build and support integrations using EIB, Core Connectors, Workday Studio and web services, including error handling, monitoring and re\-run procedures.
* Act as the technical authority on integration issues raised by vendors and downstream system owners, and drive root cause analysis to closure.
* Build advanced, matrix, composite reporting, and advise stakeholders on the right reporting approach rather than building every request as asked.
* Ensure reporting and integration outputs respect data privacy, segregation of duties and audit requirements.

**Work Sizing, Prioritization and Distribution**

* Assess the complexity, risk and effort of each incoming requirement and assign it to the right owner across the delivery group, which includes internal HRIS team members and our Workday consultant.
* Balance workload across internal team members and consultant capacity, track progress against commitments, and escalate early when a commitment is at risk.
* Review the work of internal team members and the consultant, provide technical coaching, and raise the overall configuration capability of the group.

**Sourcing Decisions at Intake**

* Decide at the point of intake, rather than mid\-delivery, which items should go to the consultant from the start and which the internal HRIS team should own, based on complexity, specialist skill requirements, timeline pressure and internal capacity.
* Prepare scope and requirement documentation for consultant\-delivered work, review the designs and deliverables that come back, and hold the consultant to quality and timeline expectations.
* Track the split between internal and consultant delivery, and advise leadership on where that boundary should sit as internal capability grows.

**Subject Matter Expertise Required**


The candidate must demonstrate working familiarity with all Workday modules in our footprint and deep, demonstrable subject matter expertise in the following two areas:

* **Advanced Compensation**, including compensation and merit plan configuration, eligibility rules, compensation review cycles, bonus and stock processes, matrices and worksheet configuration, and troubleshooting cycle issues under time pressure.
* **Integrations**, including EIB, Core Connectors, Workday Studio, web services, integration security configuration, and the operational support model that keeps integrations running.

**About this role:**


Wells Fargo is seeking a Quantitative Analytics Senior Manager.


Wells Fargo's Enterprise Model Risk Management (MRM) organization is seeking a Senior Manager to lead the Wells Fargo India and Philippines (WFIP) Derivative Pricing Model Risk Management Team within the Trading and Markets Model Risk Management Group.


The role leads a team of quantitative analysts responsible for the oversight of derivative pricing models used in trading and valuation across equities, rates, foreign exchange, credit, commodities, and structured products. Responsibilities span the model lifecycle, including model identification, risk assessment, validation, ongoing monitoring, overlay review, issue management, and governance.


The Manager will work closely with U.S.\-based Model Risk managers, validators, model developers, model owners, quantitative research teams, traders, audit, and regulators. The role also includes building WFIP capabilities, managing global resources, and improving the efficiency and consistency of model risk management processes through automation and AI.

**In this role, you will:**

* Manage and develop teams responsible for the creation, implementation of complex financial and statistical models
* Analyze and manage risks to forecast losses or enable decision making for business, product, marketing, or other functional areas
* Support financial products, portfolios, business process and risk management
* Perform various compliance with corporate and regulatory reporting, involving finance and capitalization requirements
* Determine scope and prioritization of work
* Perform key input in the development of strategy, policies, procedures, and organizational controls
* Manage one or more teams of highly skilled quantitative analysts or managers
* Interface with internal and external audit or regulators
* Manage allocation of people and financial resources for Quantitative Analytics
* Develop and guide a culture of talent development to meet business objectives and strategy
* **Team Leadership and WFIP Development**
	+ Manage, develop, and retain a team of quantitative analysts.
	+ Recruit, onboard, coach, and evaluate team members.
	+ Develop technical and leadership capabilities within the team.
	+ Support workforce planning, succession planning, and organizational growth.
	+ Establish effective collaboration between WFIP and U.S.\-based teams.
* **Model Risk Management**
	+ Lead model risk management activities across the derivative pricing model lifecycle, including:
	+ Model identification and inventory management
	+ Risk ranking and risk assessment
	+ Validation and annual review
	+ Ongoing monitoring
	+ Overlay review and challenge
	+ Issue and limitation management
	+ Provide independent challenge of model methodology, assumptions, implementation, limitations, overlays, and model use.
	+ Ensure compliance with model risk policies, standards, and regulatory requirements.
	+ Present model risk assessments, findings, and recommendations to management and governance committees.
* **Project and Resource Management**
	+ Manage a portfolio of model risk management projects.
	+ Oversee resource allocation, project planning, prioritization, and delivery.
	+ Coordinate work across WFIP and U.S.\-based teams.
	+ Monitor project execution, dependencies, and delivery timelines.
* **AI, Automation, and Standardization**
	+ Implement Generative AI, automation, and analytics solutions to improve model risk management processes.
	+ Develop reusable validation tools, libraries, testing frameworks, and knowledge repositories.

**About the Role :**
 We are seeking an experienced and technically adept Product Owner (TPO) to join our expanding Product Management team. You will act as the bridge between business, design, and engineering \- owning the product backlog and driving the delivery of features that align with business outcomes and user needs. You will be involved in everything from requirements gathering and story writing to solution design and customer documentation.
   

  

**Job Requirements**
 Essential Qualifications

* Proven success delivering products built on Java, data\-driven architectures, and APIs.
* Experience delivering or supporting AI/ML\-powered features, such as intelligent alerts, predictive analytics, or NLP\-driven workflows.
* Strong understanding of AI\-enhanced user experiences, and ability to write product requirements that align AI capabilities with business value.
* Demonstrated success working in product\-driven SaaS environments.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills across technical and business audiences.

* Strong analytical skills for feature validation, requirement refinement, and product performance assessment.

* Experienced in collaborating with Architects/Tech Leads to design scalable solutions and challenge assumptions constructively.
* Skilled in negotiating trade\-offs between scope, resources, and impact to align with product roadmaps.
* Contributes to strategic planning and long\-term roadmap development.
* Adaptable and comfortable working in fast\-paced, evolving environments.
* Able to operate in globally distributed teams across time zones and cultural contexts.

* Carry the product/feature from concept to creation.
* Brainstorm product/feature ideas and their value proposition to our client base.
* Distill the vision into documents such as product roadmap and product/feature specifications via deep dives into the domain, gathering requirements and/or business analysis.
* Work closely with engineers/architects to translate the product specification to design, and then to the product itself.
* Prepare comprehensive business test cases/beds to aid the engineering process.
* Rigorously and continuously evaluate the progress of product/feature\-in\-flight by leveraging the created test cases/beds and ensure compliance to the product/feature specification and the vision.
* Prepare prototypes using Python and AI.
* Track and question risks/assumptions.
* Proactively escalate issues and mitigate execution risks.
* Conduct competitor analysis.


**What You'll Need** 
  

  

* 4\+ years of experience working in the front, middle, and/or back\-office space with a minimum of 2\+ years of experience in product management.
* Technical skills:
+ Understanding of Java: familiarity with Java concepts to effectively communicate and collaborate with the development team.
+ Knowledge of distributed systems: understanding of distributed systems concepts to grasp project requirements and challenges.
+ Database awareness: general knowledge of relational and NoSQL databases to contribute effectively to data\-related discussions.

* Experience working closely with engineers.
* Outstanding academic background and passion to work in a high\-tech software development environment.
* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills.
* Critical thinking and the ability to articulate standpoints/ideas and influence stakeholders.
* Ability to multitask and manage multiple lines of execution with attention to detail and quality.
* A healthy combination of resourcefulness, domain expertise, creativity, and execution prowess.
* Graduate degree in software engineering.
* Advanced knowledge in trade accounting and operations, or certifications in the financial domain such as MBA or CFA, will be an added advantage.
* Hands\-on experience using and integrating various AI tools for building products will be an added advantage.

jobs.title: Product Owner (Experience)
jobs.description:
**Keyloop bridges the gap between dealers, manufacturers, technology suppliers and car buyers.**
 We empower car dealers and manufacturers to fully embrace digital transformation. How? By creating innovative technology that makes selling cars better for our customers, and buying and owning cars better for theirs.
   

  

 We use cutting\-edge technology to link our clients’ systems, departments and sites. We provide an open technology platform that’s shaping the industry for the future. We use data to help clients become more efficient, increase profitability and give more customers an amazing experience.
 **Want to be part of it?**
**Purpose of the Role**
 The Product Owner owns the outcomes of a customer\-facing product area: things dealers and their staff use every day, like booking, workshop scheduling, or repair order management. You'll work closely with the Product Manager to turn strategic direction into a prioritised backlog, and with an agile engineering team to get customer\-focused improvements shipped quickly.
   

  

 This is a fast\-moving, iteration\-heavy role. You'll be close to real user feedback and expected to adjust the backlog based on what you learn, not just what was planned.
   

  

 AI tooling is a growing and permanent part of how our Product and Engineering teams work, and this role is evolving with it. We expect Product Owners to grow into hands\-on AI\-building over time. This is a deliberate direction for the role, not a distant possibility, and we're looking for people who are genuinely ready and willing to make that journey, even if they're not there yet.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Own and prioritise the development team backlog to ensure high\-value delivery
* Write, refine, and prioritise epics and user stories with clear acceptance criteria
* Act as the voice of the customer, representing dealer and end\-user needs in every backlog decision
* Collaborate with the development team during Iteration Planning, stand\-ups, and reviews
* Accept completed user stories against the Definition of Done
* Work with the Product Manager to keep the team backlog aligned to the wider product roadmap
* Monitor product usage and performance metrics, and use them to inform prioritisation
* Translate product strategy into concrete, sequenced pieces of work


**Working with AI: where this role is going**
* Use AI tools (e.g. Claude) to support day\-to\-day product work now: drafting specs, exploring data, speeding up research and analysis
* Grow into hands\-on use of AI coding tools (e.g. Claude Code) to prototype and validate ideas yourself, with structured training and time provided to get there
* Apply judgement on where AI\-assisted output needs human review
* Understand that this capability will become a core, evaluated part of the role over time, not an optional extra


**Skills, Know\-how And Experience**
**Must have**
* Solid understanding of Agile principles and the Product Owner role within Scaled Agile
* Proven ability to write clear, concise epics and user stories
* Strong communication skills, comfortable representing the customer view to engineering and to the Product Manager
* Ability to read data and use it to make prioritisation calls
* Familiarity with customer\-centric product development
* Comfortable using AI tools day\-to\-day to support product work (e.g. research, writing, analysis), plus a clear, genuine willingness to grow into hands\-on AI\-building (e.g. Claude Code) as this becomes a core part of the role. This is where the Product Owner role at Keyloop is deliberately heading. Candidates should be ready to commit to that development path, even if not yet hands\-on today


**Preferred**
* Experience in a Scaled Agile environment (e.g. Scrum@Scale, SAFe)
* Familiarity with Jira, Confluence, or similar tools
* Relevant certifications (e.g. CSPO, SAFe POPM)
* Experience in automotive, dealer software, or similar B2B SaaS domains
* Understanding of automotive aftersales processes (e.g. service booking, workshop operations, repair order lifecycle)


 Existing hands\-on experience using AI coding tools (e.g. Claude Code) to build or prototype software
   

  

**Development pathway**
 Growing into hands\-on AI\-building is an expected part of every Product Owner's development here. This isn't an exception process, it's the plan for everyone. We'll invest in structured training and dedicated time to help you get there. What matters on day one is genuine readiness and willingness to make that journey, not that you've already arrived.
   

  

**Why join us?**
 We’re on a journey to become market leaders in our space \- and with that comes some incredible opportunities. Collaborate and learn from industry experts from all over the globe. Work with game\-changing products and services. Get the training and support you need to try new things, adapt to quick changes and explore different paths. Join Keyloop and progress your career, your way.
   

  

**An inclusive environment to thrive**
 We’re committed to fostering an inclusive work environment. One that respects all dimensions of diversity. We promote an inclusive culture within our business, and we celebrate different employees and lifestyles \- not just on key days, but every day.
   

  

**Be rewarded for your efforts**
 We believe people should be paid based on their performance so our pay and benefits reflect this and are designed to attract the very best talent. We encourage everyone in our organisation to explore opportunities which enable them to grow their career through investment in their development but equally by working in a culture which fosters support and unbridled collaboration.

IND Staff Project Manager \- GCC075
   

  

 We’re determined to make a difference and are proud to be an insurance company that goes well beyond coverages and policies. Working here means having every opportunity to achieve your goals – and to help others accomplish theirs, too. Join our team as we help shape the future.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 The IT Resiliency Product Owner is responsible for defining, prioritizing, and driving the delivery of enterprise resiliency and recovery capabilities across The Hartford’s technology landscape. This role serves as the bridge between business objectives, technology teams, and resiliency strategy ensuring critical services can withstand, respond to, and rapidly recover from disruptive events including cyber incidents, infrastructure failures, and data center outages.
   

  

 This role owns the resiliency product vision and roadmap, with a focus on disaster recovery (DR), cyber recovery (CR), resiliency, and AI/ automation at scale. The Product Owner partners with governance, engineering, cyber, risk, and business stakeholders to deliver capabilities that are measurable, testable, and audit\-ready aligned with enterprise standards and regulatory expectations.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Product Strategy \& Roadmap**
* Define and own the enterprise resiliency product strategy, roadmap, and backlog aligned to recovery priorities and risk posture.
* Translate resiliency objectives (e.g., Foundation Services (Tier\-0\) readiness, RTC/RTO/RPO adherence, cyber recovery) into prioritized deliverables and measurable outcomes.
* Align product roadmap with enterprise transformation initiatives (cloud adoption, hybrid landscape, disaster recovery/ cyber resilience maturity).


**Delivery Execution \& Agile Product Ownership**
* Act as Product Owner for resiliency platforms and capabilities (e.g., DR orchestration, recovery automation, IRE, validation frameworks).
* Manage and prioritize backlog, user stories, and acceptance criteria for governance and engineering.
* Partner with engineering leads to ensuring timely, high\-quality delivery of features and enhancements.
* Drive sprint planning, backlog refinement, and product demos with clear success criteria.


**Resiliency \& Recovery Capabilities**
* Lead development of enterprise capabilities including:
+ Disaster Recovery and Cyber Recovery orchestration
+ Automated recovery runbooks and validation frameworks
+ Isolated Recovery Environment (IRE) capabilities
+ Foundation Services (Tier\-0\) and critical application resiliency onboarding

* Ensure capabilities are designed for scalability, repeatability, and auditability (evidence\-based validation).


**Stakeholder Engagement \& Governance**
* Partner with Technology, Cybersecurity, Risk, Compliance, and Business stakeholders to define requirements and ensure alignment.
* Support the Governance team by coordinating resiliency standards, maintaining policies and procedures, tracking compliance requirements, and driving follow\-up on identified gaps and action items.
* Provide executive\-level reporting on product progress, risk posture, and resiliency maturity.
* Define and track OKRs (e.g., recovery success rates, automation coverage, validation completion, audit findings).


**Innovation \& Automation**
* Drive adoption of automation, AI/GenAI, and analytics in resiliency and recovery processes.
* Identify opportunities to reduce manual effort and improve speed, consistency, and reliability of recovery execution.
* Enable self\-service and productized recovery capabilities for application teams.


**Required Qualifications**
**Required Skills \& Qualifications**
* 5–8\+ years of experience in IT, with a focus on Product Ownership, Resiliency, Disaster Recovery (DR), Cyber Recovery (CR), or related domains.
* Proven experience operating as a Product Owner in an Agile environment (Scrum/Kanban), including backlog management and stakeholder alignment.
* Strong understanding of resiliency concepts:
+ Disaster Recovery (DR), Business Continuity (BCP), Cyber Recovery
+ RTO/RPO, failover/failback, recovery orchestration

* Demonstrated ability to translate business risk and requirements into technical capabilities.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to engage both technical teams and executive stakeholders.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with enterprise resiliency tools/platforms (e.g., Rally, ServiceNow, BCM tools, orchestration platforms).
* Experience supporting regulatory, audit, or compliance requirements in financial services.
* Familiarity with frameworks such as NIST CSF, ISO 22301, or similar resiliency standards.
* Experience with automation, scripting, or AI/GenAI\-enabled workflows in operational environments.
* Certification(s) such as Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO), AWS/Azure certifications, or DR/BCP certifications.


**Key Competencies**
* Strategic thinking and product mindset
* Risk\-based decision making
* Data\-driven and outcome\-oriented execution
* Strong collaboration and stakeholder influence
* Continuous improvement and innovation focus


**Success Measures**
* Increased automation and standardization of recovery processes
* Improved recovery validation rates and audit readiness
* Reduction in recovery time and operational risk exposure
* Adoption of resiliency products across foundation servers (Tier\-0\) / critical applications


 Measurable improvements in cyber and disaster recovery prepared

Education / Experience

Challenging. Meaningful. Life\-changing. Those aren’t words that are usually associated with a job. But working at Bristol Myers Squibb is anything but usual. Here, uniquely interesting work happens every day, in every department. Each of us is empowered to apply our individual talents and unique perspectives in a supportive culture, promoting global participation in clinical trials, while our shared values of passion, innovation, urgency, accountability, inclusion and integrity bring out the highest potential of each of our colleagues.

BMS has an occupancy structure that determines where an employee is required to conduct their work.  **CIM\- Data Enablement Team** **\- Business Project Lead Analyst**

 **Position Summary:**


The **Business Project Lead Analyst** serves as a strategic partner to Finance, Investment, and Technology stakeholders, leading business analysis, project execution, data and reporting initiatives, and testing activities across enterprise transformation programs. The role requires strong expertise in stakeholder management, requirements management, data analytics, and quality assurance, with the ability to translate complex business needs into scalable technology and data solutions that drive measurable business value.

The Business Project Lead Analyst partners with the CIM DET and workstream owner structure. Key stakeholder partners will be Finance, Accounting, Technical Teams and Automation and AI teams.

* Collaborate with Workstream Lead, vendors, and technical team to support requirements identification, documentation and communication to technical partners.
* Support design conversations to support technical and functional requirements.
* Support review of functional design and technical design documentation as needed
* Support the identification of testing scenarios and correlated test scripts.
* Support the generation of training materials with the use of content creation technologies
* Provide support as an early tester of capabilities
* Engage with stakeholders to support requirements gathering and understanding.
* Support driving project deliverables on time, on budget with quality results
* Continuous improvement in the identification of opportunities for process improvement or process enhancements in day\-to\-day execution
* Familiarity with burn down chart development/management and field mapping
* UAT Plan development and execution. Assistance with test scenarios
* Assistance with defects for end\-to\-end testing
* Involvement in data analysis and reporting

**Competencies / Skills:**

* Understanding of Investment/Finance processes (GL, Subledgers, FP\&A, cost allocations, forecasting, etc)
* Ability to review deliverables for completeness, quality, and compliance with established project standards.
* Strong business acumen including ability to effectively articulate business objectives.
* Analytical skills, Highly Focused, Team player, Versatile, Resourceful
* Ability to learn and apply quickly, including ability to effectively impart knowledge to others.
* Precise communication skills, including an ability to project clarity and precision in verbal and written communication and strong presentation skills.
* Excellent negotiation, influencing, and relationship management skills with the ability to work across business, finance, accounting, and technology teams
* Requirements gathering
* Hands\-on experience executing test cases, driving SIT/UAT, creating test scenarios, managing defects, coordinating business sign\-offs, and ensuring quality delivery.
* Strong SQL skills and experience with Power BI/Tableau, data analysis, data quality, ETL processes, APIs, and data governance concepts
* Expert in requirements gathering, BRDs/FRDs, user stories, process mapping, stakeholder workshops, and solution design reviews.

**Experience Required:**

* **Experience**: 5 to 8 years in business or systems analysis, including writing business specifications, technical design documents and solution overviews
* **Domain Knowledge**: Finance / Investment Process.
* **Technical Skills**: Familiarity with tools like **SQL** (Data analysis, validation, and troubleshooting), **Reporting** (Power BI, Tableau), Alteryx, Dataiku, JIRA, Toad, or similar tools
* Knowledge of API and ETL Concepts
* **Methodologies**: Agile, SCRUM, SDLC, and Waterfall are commonly used frameworks
* **Documentation**: Proficiency in creating BRDs, FRDs, SRS, UAT plans, and Requirements Traceability Matrices (RTM) is essential

**Preferred Attributes**

* Strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills
* Ability to manage multiple projects and timelines independently
* Strategic and tactical thinking for high\-level design reviews
* Strong analytical and structured problem‑solving skills

**Good to have Skills**

* Knowledge or experience in Python
* Agile/Scrum certifications.
* Experience with AI, automation, or digital transformation initiatives.
* Knowledge or experience in Databricks or similar analytical platforms.
* Knowledge or experience of Airflow
* Knowledge or experience in data management, governance, and quality.

jobs.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  

  

  

Make your mark by leading global asset pricing controls that help protect clients and the firm, while growing your career in a collaborative team.
As a Reference Data Analyst within Instrument, Pricing \& Common Reference Data, you deliver daily global asset pricing services and ensure data integrity across multiple business lines. You capture and validate bond prices, analyze market movements, and partner with vendors and technology teams to resolve issues and minimize risk. You lead through detail, sound judgment, and clear communication in a fast\-paced environment.
**Job Responsibilities:**
* Capture and validate daily third\-party bond prices against multiple market sources, analyzing price movements in relation to market news and expectations.
* Liaise with pricing vendors to resolve issues, minimize risk, and ensure accurate pricing data.
* Monitor systems for job success, promptly resolve issues with technology teams, and escalate concerns to supervisors as needed.
* Prepare and distribute daily pricing and market impact summaries, including supporting market news, and generate month\-end index rebalance and composition reports by tracking new bond issuance and auction and buyback activities.
* Produce and analyze valuation movements within client portfolios on a daily and monthly basis, completing all required tasks and reporting accurately and on time.
* Respond to client (Global Index Research Group) queries professionally, participate in monthly client meetings, and present relevant findings and updates.
* Contribute to ongoing improvements in the pricing control process and support ad hoc project work as directed.


**Required qualifications, skills, and capabilities:**
* Bring 12\+ years of experience in fixed income roles, including team management experience and an understanding of stocks, bonds, options, and financial markets.
* Demonstrate knowledge of industry activities, including corporate actions, index benchmarking, stock markets, and fixed income products, along with familiarity with pricing vendors such as Bloomberg and Reuters.
* Apply advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including PivotTables and VLOOKUP, alongside strong numerical and analytical skills and attention to detail.
* Communicate effectively within teams and across departments while working accurately under pressure, balancing multiple priorities independently in a fast\-paced environment.


**Preferred qualifications, skills, and capabilities:**
* Use additional pricing and analytics platforms beyond Bloomberg and Reuters, such as FactSet and ICE Data.
* Hold an advanced degree or professional certification in finance, mathematics, or a related field.
* Leverage automation tools or programming languages, such as Python or Visual Basic for Applications, to support process improvement.
* Lead process optimization or technology integration projects in a financial services environment.

**ABOUT US**  

  

  

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.  

  

We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

  

  

  

**ABOUT THE TEAM**
  

  

J.P. Morgan's Commercial \& Investment Bank is a global leader across banking, markets, securities services and payments. Corporations, governments and institutions throughout the world entrust us with their business in more than 100 countries. The Commercial \& Investment Bank provides strategic advice, raises capital, manages risk and extends liquidity in markets around the world.

* Samskriti Business Solutions Pvt. Ltd. is seeking a results\-driven Senior Digital Marketing Analyst to join our growing digital marketing team. The ideal candidate will have 4–6 years of hands\-on experience in planning, executing, and optimizing multi\-channel digital marketing campaigns for B2B and/or B2C businesses.
* This role requires a strong understanding of performance marketing, SEO, analytics, marketing automation, and customer acquisition strategies. The successful candidate will work closely with internal teams and clients to drive measurable business outcomes through data\-driven digital marketing initiatives.
**Key Responsibilities*** Develop, execute, and optimize integrated digital marketing campaigns across Paid Search, SEO, Social Media, Affiliate Marketing, Display \& Video Advertising, and Email Marketing.
* Identify growth opportunities and recommend strategies to improve lead generation, customer acquisition, engagement, and revenue.
* Manage campaign budgets and ensure marketing investments deliver measurable ROI.
* Plan and manage paid advertising campaigns across Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Meta Ads, and other relevant platforms.
* Monitor campaign performance, analyze key metrics, and implement optimization strategies to improve conversions and reduce acquisition costs.
* Conduct audience segmentation, A/B testing, and landing page optimization initiatives.
* Monitor organic search visibility and recommend actions to improve rankings and traffic.
* Develop and implement Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) strategies to improve brand visibility across AI\-powered search platforms and answer engines.
* Optimize website content to increase eligibility for AI\-generated responses, featured snippets, knowledge panels, and zero\-click search experiences.
* Conduct research on conversational search behavior and user intent to create content that aligns with AI\-driven search experiences.
* Develop and execute social media strategies to enhance brand awareness, audience engagement, and community growth.
* Plan and execute email marketing campaigns, including audience segmentation, nurturing workflows, A/B testing, and performance analysis.
* Monitor email deliverability and campaign effectiveness.
* Utilize analytics platforms such as Google Analytics 4 (GA4\), Google Tag Manager, Search Console, and marketing automation tools to track performance.
* Analyze website traffic, user behavior, conversion funnels, and campaign results.
* Prepare regular reports, dashboards, and actionable insights for clients.
* Present recommendations to improve campaign effectiveness and overall marketing performance.
* Stay current with industry trends, emerging technologies, AI\-driven marketing solutions, and digital marketing best practices.
* Conduct competitor research and market analysis to identify opportunities and industry benchmarks.
**Qualifications \& Experience*** Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, or a related field.
* 4–6 years of experience in digital marketing, performance marketing, or growth marketing roles.
* Proven experience managing campaigns across multiple digital marketing channels.
* Strong understanding of SEO, Paid Search, Social Media Marketing, Affiliate Marketing, Email Marketing.
* Experience with Google Analytics 4 (GA4\), Google Ads, Google Tag Manager, Search Console, LinkedIn Ads, Meta Ads, and SEO tools such as SEMrush, Ahrefs, or similar platforms.
* Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, and reporting skills.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple projects, priorities, and deadlines in a fast\-paced environment.
* Experience working with B2B SaaS, Professional Services, Healthcare, E\-commerce, or Lead Generation campaigns.

 We are changing the way people think about customer care, and we need your help!
   

  

 We’re looking for an AI \& Data Business Analyst to bridge the gap between business strategy, data analytics, and artificial intelligence. You will assist with performing User Acceptance Testing (UAT), the operationalization of business, process, and system changes, and driving data\-driven decisions through dashboard creation and AI\-powered insights across training curriculums, quality assurance, and reporting.

Apollo.io is the leading go\-to\-market solution for revenue teams, trusted by over 500,000 companies and millions of users globally, from rapidly growing startups to some of the world's largest enterprises. Founded in 2015, the company is one of the fastest growing companies in SaaS, raising approximately $250 million to date and valued at $1\.6 billion. Apollo.io provides sales and marketing teams with easy access to verified contact data for over 210 million B2B contacts and 35 million companies worldwide, along with tools to engage and convert these contacts in one unified platform. By helping revenue professionals find the most accurate contact information and automating the outreach process, Apollo.io turns prospects into customers. Apollo raised a series D in 2023 and is backed by top\-tier investors, including Sequoia Capital, Bain Capital Ventures, and more, and counts the former President and COO of Hubspot, JD Sherman, among its board members.

### **Your Role \& Mission**



As a Senior Backend Engineer at Apollo, you'll be a critical part of a fast\-growing company, working on a cross\-functional team to build highly scalable systems and set the bar for how we engineer. The way we build has changed: this is an **AI\-native** role. We're not looking for someone who *also* uses AI, we're looking for someone who thinks *with* it, forms their own hypotheses, pressure\-tests what AI produces, catches its errors, and design more robustly than they could alone.



You'll work in an open, collaborative environment, give and receive hands\-on mentorship, and have real opportunities to grow. You'll interface daily with design, front\-end, analytics, product, and teams beyond Engineering. You enjoy working cross\-functionally to solve hard problems and make an impact. You strive for quality, are obsessed with improving it, automation, monitoring, squashing the bugs that sneak through and you're always investigating performance improvements and better ideas.


### **Daily Adventures \& Responsibilities**


* Design and implement highly scalable, highly available backend services with proper monitoring and alerting in place
* Ramp quickly into large, unfamiliar codebases, de\-risk your changes, understand blast radius, and ship with confidence
* Use AI as a core part of your workflow: generate and pressure\-test approaches, verify and catch AI's mistakes, and stand behind the quality of the code you ship with it
* Drive the full lifecycle of software development: product requirements, architecture, solution design, development, quality assurance, and maintenance, ownership doesn't end at deploy
* Scope and reshape under\-specified problems, and write clear design docs that satisfy real product needs
* Partner closely with PMs: translate product intent into technical decisions, surface the technical realities they need to make good calls, and push back on the spec when reality changes the answer
* Mentor others on best practices and effectively share knowledge to up\-level the team
* Communicate progress clearly to the product lead, engineering manager, and other stakeholders
* Introduce new technologies and ideas when they earn their place
* Give and receive technical and behavioral feedback; engage in scrum ceremonies, team culture, and collaborate with the team.

### **What We're Looking For**


* **AI\-native engineers.** You use AI to raise your bar, not just move faster forming your own hypotheses, pressure\-testing and verifying AI output, catching its errors, and taking full ownership of code quality regardless of how it was produced. You stay current with a fast\-moving toolset.
* **Comfort in unfamiliar code.** You ramp fast into systems you didn't write, reason about blast radius, and de\-risk changes rather than hoping they work.
* **Architectural ownership \& operational readiness.** You design for scale and availability, anticipate failure modes, and build with monitoring and alerting from the start.
* **Ownership start to finish.** Just because a project has been deployed doesn't mean it's done. You own outcomes , think end to end in terms of product and are customer obsessed
* **Collaboration you can trust.** You let others speak, seek to understand their viewpoints, and are the kind of teammate people want to build with.
* **Product judgment.** You care about the customer outcome, make the technical calls that produce a great product, and know when to challenge a spec.
* **Growth \& learning.** You actively improve your craft, your team, and how you work.
* **Proactivity.** You act without being told, identify areas of improvement, and drive best practices.
* **Comfort with ambiguity.** You can operate without a fully\-specified problem and bring structure to it.
* **Organization \& planning.** You break large projects into smaller pieces that are easier to estimate and deliver.
* **Strong communication.** Clear in writing and in person, across technical and non\-technical audiences.

### **Qualifications**


* Minimum 5\+ years of industry experience in backend development, at least 3\-4 years in senior positions, building large\-scale applications with right observability.
* Solid computer science fundamentals, data structures, algorithms, and object\-oriented design
* Fluency using AI tools in real development work, plus the judgment to verify and pressure\-test their output rather than trusting it blindly
* Experience developing distributed web applications
* Write code that is comprehensible, well\-structured, and highly performant
* Experience with database modeling (SQL or NoSQL both fine)
* Experience using and designing RESTful services


**Must have:** Curiosity, AI\-native engineering judgment, communication skills, problem solving.


**Nice to have:** BS or MS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or similar; GCP, Kubernetes, Docker, Mongo, Redis, Ruby on Rails, Microservices, Machine Learning

Education

Skills \& Competencies
