**We are seeking a visionary, highly skilled, and innovative** **UX Designer** (4–8 Years) to join our high\-impact Team. In this role, you will lead the user experience and visual design strategy for cutting\-edge digital platforms, AI\-driven tools, and complex enterprise software. You will turn ambiguous, high\-tech concepts into elegant, intuitive, and high\-performing digital products.


**Qualification \& Experience:**

**Education:** Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Human\-Computer Interaction (HCI), Interaction Design, Visual Communication, Industrial Design, Computer Science, or a related field. (Specialized degree or academic background in UX Design is a strong plus)


**Required Certification:** Must hold at least one recognized professional UI/UX design certification (e.g., **NN/g UX Master / Certified** , **Interaction Design Foundation (IxDF)** , **Google UX Design Professional Certificate** , or **HCI Certification** ).


**Experience:** **4 to 8 years** of hands\-on experience in end\-to\-end product design, UX research, interaction design, and complex enterprise or AI tool interfaces.


**Key Responsibilities**

**End\-to\-End Product Design:** Lead the complete design lifecycle—from generative research, user journey mapping, and wireframing to high\-fidelity UI design, prototyping, and design system maintenance.


**Lab Innovation \& AI Interface Design:** Design ground\-breaking, intuitive user experiences tailored for AI/ML and Computer Vision workflows (e.g., visual data annotation platforms, spatial AI dashboards, real\-time diagnostic interfaces).


**User Research \& Usability Testing:** Conduct qualitative and quantitative user research, contextual inquiries, and usability tests with domain experts, engineers, and end\-users to validate complex workflows.


**Design Systems \& Scalability:** Define, govern, and scale comprehensive design systems and component libraries to ensure visual and functional consistency across all lab applications.


**Rapid Prototyping:** Create interactive, high\-fidelity prototypes (using Figma, Protopie, etc.) to communicate micro\-interactions, motion design, and complex data visualizations to stakeholders and developers.


**Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** Partner closely with Product Managers, Machine Learning Engineers, and Full\-Stack Developers to ensure design feasibility, technical alignment, and seamless execution.


**Advocacy \& Mentorship:** Drive a human\-centered design culture across the lab, mentoring junior team members and advocating for best accessibility (WCAG) and UX standards.  



  

**Technical Essentials**

* **Design \& Prototyping Tools:** Expertise in modern design suites (Figma, Sketch, Adobe XD) and advanced prototyping tools (Principle, ProtoPie, Framer).
* **UX Research \& Testing:** Proven ability to run end\-to\-end UX research using tools like Maze, UserTesting, Hotjar, or contextual interviews.
* **Design Systems:** Demonstrated capability in building and maintaining tokenized, accessible design systems at scale.
* **Information Architecture \& Interaction:** Deep knowledge of information architecture, wireframing, micro\-interactions, and visual hierarchy for data\-dense applications.
* **Technical \& Frontend Literacy:** Working understanding of web technologies (HTML5, CSS/Tailwind, component\-based frameworks like React/Vue) to ensure design feasibility during developer handoff.
* **Accessibility Standards:** Mastery of inclusive design principles and WCAG 2\.1/2\.2 accessibility compliance.

### **Soft Skills \& Behavioral Attributes**

* **Strategic Product Mindset:** Ability to balance complex technological capabilities (AI/ML) with actual user needs and business goals.
* **Innovative \& Creative Problem\-Solver:** Thrives in an ambiguous, lab\-oriented environment where novel user experience paradigms must be invented from scratch.
* **High Empathy \& User Advocacy:** Deep passion for understanding complex user workflows and translating technical pain points into frictionless digital experiences.
* **Articulate Communication:** Strong storytelling and presentation skills to justify design decisions to senior executive leadership and technical teams.

**Nice\-to\-Have / Added Advantages**
-------------------------------------

* **Prior experience designing interfaces for** **AI/ML tools, Computer Vision datasets, spatial computing, or industrial/aerospace software** .
* **Knowledge of quantitative analytics tools (Amplitude, Mixpanel) to drive data\-informed design iterations.**
* **An active online portfolio demonstrating end\-to\-end UX problem solving, design systems, and product innovation case studies.**

**Success Metrics**
-------------------

* **User Experience \& Satisfaction:** High System Usability Scale (SUS) scores and positive user adoption metrics across lab\-launched platforms.
* **Design Quality \& Consistency:** Timely delivery of scalable, accessible, and high\-fidelity design artifacts backed by well\-maintained design systems.
* **Innovation \& Impact:** Successful introduction of novel UI patterns and AI interaction models that simplify complex engineering processes.
* **Collaboration Efficiency:** Seamless developer handoff, low rework rates, and strong cross\-functional alignment throughout the product delivery cycle.

Two of our hospitals have international accreditation from the Joint Commission International (JCI), and 19 hospitals have domestic accreditation from the National Accreditation Board for Hospitals (NABH).For more details, please refer to our website at: https://www.narayanahealth.org
 **About Medha:** 
 Medha is the Advanced Analytics \& AI arm of Narayana Health, focused on transforming healthcare through data, intelligence, and thoughtfully designed digital products. Our mission is to simplify decision\-making across hospitals, clinics, and care teams by bringing clarity, precision, and actionability to every layer of healthcare operations.Our products power large health systems, influence mission\-critical workflows, and support clinical and non\-clinical teams in delivering safer, faster, and more coordinated care.

**https://www.medha\-analytics.ai/** 
**Why Join Medha:** 
* Shape next\-generation healthcare intelligence products that drive decisions for clinicians, operations leaders, and frontline care teams.

* Collaborate in a vision\-led, cross\-functional environment alongside Engineering, Design, Data, and Clinical domain experts.

**Job Purpose:** 
* The Product Manager will own product roadmaps across multiple products in the Medha portfolio and lead them through the full lifecycle — from discovery and prioritisation to delivery and post\-launch optimisation.
* This role sits at the nexus of Leadership, Design, Engineering, and Quality, and also carries responsibility for user onboarding, training, and first\-line query resolution — ensuring products deliver measurable value in live healthcare environments.


**Candidate Requirements:** 
**Education:** 
 Master's in Business Administration (MBA) from a premier institute preferred; equivalent analytical or technical postgraduate qualification considered.

 3 – 6 years in product management, preferably in health\-tech, enterprise SaaS, or data/analytics\-driven products.
 **Location:** 
 Bengaluru (primary); travel as required.
 
**Key Responsibilities:** 
**Product Roadmap Ownership** 
* Own and drive product roadmaps for multiple products within the Medha portfolio, ensuring alignment with organisational strategy and business goals.
* Translate high\-level business objectives into clearly defined epics, user stories, and prioritised backlogs.
* Lead quarterly and annual roadmap planning cycles in collaboration with Leadership, balancing strategic bets with near\-term delivery commitments.
* Continuously evaluate and re\-prioritise the roadmap based on user feedback, competitive signals, and data insights.


**Cross\-functional Collaboration** 
* Partner closely with Leadership to understand strategic intent and cascade it into product direction.
* Work hand\-in\-hand with the Design team to drive user research, define experience requirements, and review design artefacts.
* Collaborate with Engineering to scope, estimate, and deliver features on time with high quality — participating in sprint planning, grooming, and retrospectives.
* Engage with the Quality team to define acceptance criteria, support UAT, and ensure post\-release stability.


**User Training \& Query Resolution** 
* Lead user onboarding and training sessions for new product releases, ensuring clinical and operational users are confident and proficient.
* Create and maintain user\-facing documentation, FAQs, and training guides tailored to varied user personas (clinical, operational, administrative).
* Serve as the primary escalation point for user queries, coordinating with Engineering and QA for swift resolution of product issues.
* Track recurring issues and user pain points, feeding them into the product roadmap as prioritised improvement items.


**Discovery \& Validation** 
* Conduct user interviews, contextual inquiry, and observational research across hospital environments to deeply understand workflows and unmet needs.
* Perform market research and competitive analysis to identify opportunities for product differentiation and innovation.
* Define and validate hypotheses through rapid prototyping, pilots, and structured feedback loops.


**Product Documentation \& Metrics** 
* Author and maintain comprehensive product documentation: PRDs, user stories, feature specifications, and release notes.
* Define product KPIs and success metrics; build dashboards and reports to track adoption, engagement, and outcome impact.
* Drive post\-launch reviews, compiling lessons learned and sharing actionable recommendations with stakeholders.


**Go\-to\-Market \& Stakeholder Communication** 
* Develop product positioning, messaging frameworks, and internal communication plans for major releases.
* Present product updates, roadmap reviews…

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
**The Hard Thing About Data** 




  





 Most companies that claim to have a "data platform" have a dashboard with some charts and a dream. Hevo has something different. Something that took eight years to build and can't be bought. Over 2,000 companies send us their most sensitive data every single day. 100 billion events a month. Raw. Unfiltered. Before transformation, before aggregation, at the exact moment truth is created. That's not a product feature. That's trust, earned one customer at a time, over eight years, by not screwing up.
 



 That position is now the foundation for something much bigger. We're building an Intelligence Layer on top of it, a system that reads across every data source a company runs, connects the signals that matter, and tells people what to do before they have to go looking for answers. We call it the Context Graph. It's real enough to show results. Early enough that the person who joins now defines what it becomes.
 



 This is the moment. Not the moment after it's obvious. Now.
 



  





**What You're Walking Into** 




  





 You'll own a product pod. SaaS integrations, database connectors, or the Intelligence Layer, depending on where the biggest need is when you join. You own the backlog. More importantly, you own the
 *why* 
 behind everything that gets built. You report directly to the CEO. In the first 3\-6 months, your job is to make the foundation bulletproof, find the gaps in the platform, close them, and make the product sharper than it's ever been. After that, you move into the Intelligence Layer and help define what Hevo becomes in its next chapter.
 



  





**What This Job Actually Is** 




  





 Let's be honest about what great PMs do, and what mediocre ones do instead. Mediocre PMs write specs and hand them off. They synthesize feedback from CSMs and call it customer insight. They sit in architecture meetings and nod. They measure their own output in documents shipped, not outcomes delivered. That's not this job. This job is three things, done well, simultneously.
 



  





**First: Technical ownership.** 
 You will be in the room when architecture decisions get made. Not watching. Contributing. Pushing back. Asking the questions that change the direction of the decision. You need to understand how data pipelines work at a systems level, CDC, connectors, streaming, schema management, failure modes. If you can't hold your own in that room, engineering will stop inviting you to it. And they'll be right to.
 



  





**Second: Direct customer engagement.** 
 You talk to customers yourself. No intermediary. No secondhand summary. You hear the problem in the customer's own words, you sit with the complexity of it, and you own the translation into product decisions. If you're relying on a CSM to tell you what customers need, you will always be one step behind.
 



  





**Third: Making complexity simple.** 
 Hevo's product is deeply technical. The people who sell it and support it are not always. A big part of your job is taking complex system behavior and making it crisp and understandable, for Support, for CS, for Solutions Engineering, so they can represent the product confidently to customers. If internal teams are confused, customers will be too.
 



  





**Who We're Looking For** 




  





 6\-8 years of product experience. Meaningful time on platform or infrastructure products at B2B companies. Not optional.
 



  





 Strong technical depth. CS degree or equivalent engineering background. You should be able to hold a real conversation about system design, data architecture, API design, and engineering tradeoffs, not a surface level one.
 



  





 Proven ability to engage directly with customers. Not customer research. Not user interviews handed to you by a researcher. Direct engagement, gathering requirements, presenting product direction, handling objections in real time.
 



  





 Clear, structured communication. Written and verbal. You can make a complex system understandable to a non\-technical audience without sacrificing accuracy. This is rarer than it sounds.
 



  





 High ownership. You don't wait for conditions to be perfect. You move. You iterate. You follow through. When you say you'll do something, it gets done.
 



  





 Nice to have: Engineer\-turned\-PM. Experience at a Series A\-C company where you had to balance speed with quality. Familiarity with the data integration and pipeline landscape.
 



  





**What Good Looks Like in Year One** 




  





 After 12 months, a great hire will have:
 



 Full, unambiguous ownership of their pod's backlog, with a defensible point of view on priorities that's grounded in customer reality and business impact.
 



 Identified and closed the most critical gaps in their product area, with improvements that customers and internal teams can actually feel.
 



 Built enough technical depth to shape architecture decisions, not observe them.
 



 Become the person in the company most connected to what customers actually need from their product area.
 



 Made internal teams measurably better at representing the product.
 



 Started actively shaping the Intelligence Layer, contributing product thinking and customer insight as Hevo moves into its next chapter.
 



  





**The Moment** 




  





 Hevo spent eight years building both a product and a business simultaneously, and the foundation is real.
 



  





 The Intelligence Layer is early. The window to define what it becomes is open right now. Most people will look at this moment in five years and wish they'd been here for it.
 



 If you're one of the people who wants to be here for it, let's talk.

**About Sarvam**
 Sarvam is building the bedrock of Sovereign AI for India. The company is developing India’s full\-stack sovereign AI platform, building across research, models, infrastructure and applications with a singular focus on making AI genuinely work for India. Sarvam works with leading enterprises and public institutions and is backed by Lightspeed, Peak XV, and Khosla Ventures. Sarvam partners with India’s leading brands, including Tata Capital, SBI Life, CRED, IDFC, and LIC.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We're building India's sovereign AI platform across API, Agents, Creator Studio, and consumer products. Acquisition is getting easier. Activation is where most of our users are dropping. We need a PM who owns the full top\-of\-funnel: how people find us, how they sign up, how they get to their first meaningful moment, and how we make sure they come back the next day.
   

  

 This role sits at the intersection of growth, product analytics, and lifecycle. You'll work closely with marketing, platform, and product teams to turn installs and signups into activated, engaged users who stick.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Signup, login, and onboarding. Own the charter of everything from the first touchpoint to an activated user, on app and off app. Design the onboarding flows. Cut steps. Pick the right activation moment per product and ship toward it.
* Activation funnels. Define what activation means for each product and instrument it end to end. Find the drop\-offs. Run experiments at every step. Move the curve.
* Marketing channels and attribution. Own the channel mix from a product standpoint. Work with marketing on paid, organic, referral, and partnerships. Build the attribution setup so we know what's actually working. Hold a clear view on CAC and channel quality.
* Quality of acquired users. Not all signups are equal. Define what a good user looks like, segment by source, and feed that back into acquisition. Kill channels that bring junk. Double down on the ones that bring repeat users.
* Virality and social loops. Build referral mechanics, social sharing, and in\-product virality where it fits. Find the wedge that turns one user into three.
* Lifecycle and re\-engagement. Ship in\-product nudges and off\-product touchpoints (email, WhatsApp, push) that get new users to the second session, the third session, the habit.


**What We’re Looking For**
* 5\+ years in product management with at least 2\-3 years owning growth, activation, or top\-of\-funnel at a startup or consumer/developer product
* You've moved an activation metric and can talk about it specifically: the baseline, what you shipped, what worked, what didn't
* Deep working knowledge of activation, engagement, and retention funnels. You understand each step, each cohort, and where the cliffs are
* Hands\-on with marketing channels and attribution. You've worked with paid, organic, referral, and lifecycle, and you know how to measure each
* You live in product analytics. Mixpanel, PostHog, Amplitude, whatever the stack is. You pull SQL when you need to. You don't wait for the data team
* You have an intuitive sense for what makes a product activate faster. Friction, time\-to\-value, the right first action. You see it without being told
* Numbers at your fingertips. CAC, activation rate, D1/D7/D30 retention, channel ROI, cohort curves. These live in your head
* Clear thinker on user quality. You don't celebrate signup numbers. You celebrate activated users who come back


**Bonus Points**
* Built referral programs or viral loops that materially moved acquisition
* Worked on developer products, AI products, or India\-first consumer products
* Background in mobile growth, including store optimization and install\-to\-activation funnels


**Why this role?**
* Real ownership. You own growth across the company. The signup page, the activation flow, the channel strategy, the referral program. Yours to shape.
* Move metrics at scale. Sarvam's products touch the entire Indian developer and consumer market. An onboarding change you ship on Monday shows up in activation dashboards by Friday. Few companies offer this kind of leverage this early.
* The best product team you'll work with. Sharp operators from the best product orgs in India. People who ship weekly, argue hard, and ship harder. You'll be pushed and you'll grow fast.
* AI at the frontier. You'll sit next to researchers building India's foundation models. Access to the latest cutting\-edge models, internal research, and a team that genuinely understands how this technology works. Not a wrapper company.
* Independence to bet big. If you have a thesis on a new acquisition channel, a virality mechanic, or an activation rebuild, bring it. We give PMs room to run their own experiments and own the outcomes, good or bad.
* The standard startup perks. Competitive cash, meaningful equity, top\-tier health insurance, great Bangalore office, a team that actually eats lunch together.


**Why Sarvam?**
 Sarvam is a fast\-moving, high talent\-density team building full\-stack AI for India, working on problems that push the frontiers of AI with real population\-scale impact.
   

  

* Work alongside researchers, engineers, builders, and business leaders who move fast and hold each other to a very high bar
* High ownership and high impact, from day one
* Everything we do is AI\-first, from the way we build and ship to the way we think about problems
* You can work on problems that could change how an entire country learns, works, and communicates


 If you want to work on problems at the frontier of AI in India, Sarvam is the place to be.

**JOB DESCRIPTION**  

  

  

Join our team to play a pivotal role in mitigating tech risks and upholding operational excellence, driving innovation in risk management.


As a Tech Risk \& Controls Lead at JPMorgan Chase within the Commercial and Investment Bank, Blockchain Engineering Group \- Kinexys business, you will be responsible for identifying, and mitigating compliance and operational risks in line with the firm's standards. You will also provide subject matter expertise and technical guidance to technology\-aligned process owners, ensuring that implemented controls are operating effectively and in compliance with regulatory, legal, and industry standards. By partnering with various stakeholders, including Product Owners, Business Control Managers, and Regulators, you will contribute to the reporting of a comprehensive view of technology risk posture and its impact on the business. You will support the Kinexys Technology Risk and Control (KTRAC) team in managing key risk and controls and facilitate interactions between cyber, operational risk and internal audit teams.


**Job Responsibilities:**

* Works with KTRAC leads to execute the robust controls framework for the Kinexys technology organization.
* Partners with Cyber and application owners to execute on controls agenda inclusive risk assessments, controls testing and evidencing, identification of control gaps and building/tracking/closing action plans.
* Collaborates with Tech/Operate SMEs to build processes, policies, procedures and programs to close control gaps identified during annual assessments and/or during BAU project development.
* Keeps abreast of regulatory changes and potential impact to controls environment. Thorough knowledge of GRC and key domains. Develop control procedures and ability to define controls
* Builds and maintains fundamental understanding of JPM Technology control standards. Develops and implement controls aligned to JPMC security standards
* Serves as tech point for tech assessment responses (inclusive of internal and 3rd party audits).
* Partners with 1/2/3 lines of defense and Tech SMEs to collect, track and disseminate artifacts and evidence requested by clients/customer/examiners/auditors
* Uses enterprise\-authorized AI capabilities within the work environment to accelerate synthesis of risk/control evidence and draft executive\-ready reporting, validating outputs and handling data according to sensitivity and security requirements
* Promotes reuse\-first, AI\-assisted approaches to streamline recurring control testing and issue/action\-plan management routines, ensuring human review and alignment to auditability and regulatory expectations
* Assists in security gaps remediation activities as applicable. Collaborates with partners to provide written responses to regulatory requests.
* Develops and maintains tight audit and exam response tracking process. Provide timely and appropriate reporting to stakeholders




**Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* 10 \+ years industry experience including Technology Risk and Controls assessment, support and management.
* Demonstrated solid understanding of technology fundamentals and evolving/emerging technologies inclusive of Information Security Architectures and Controls, CI/CD, SDLC, APIs, Cloud platforms, **Distributed ledger Technologies (blockchain)** and Architectures such as Blockchain, DevOps, Enterprise Production Operations.
* Experience with project management of risk assessment and audits. Experience in multiple cloud environment (AWS, Azure and Google)
* Experience using JIRA, Confluence and SharePoint collaboration tools. Experience and comfort working in an Agile environment. Strong familiarity with risk measurements and information security standards (E.g. NIST, ISO, SOC etc).
* Proven track record of initiating policy and control improvements and driving programs and that enhance transparency, governance or control.
* Excellent technical writing capability and oral executive\-level communications skills. Ability to anticipate and understand complex regulator and stakeholder requirements.
* Demonstrable skill to tailor complex regulatory issues into effective messages.
* Highly\-motivated, well\-organized self\-starter with exceptional judgment and strong analytical, advisory, communication, and project management skills.
* Strong team player with ability to work closely with multiple constituents. Ability to maintain sound judgement under pressure when faced with imperfect information.
* Demonstrated experience using enterprise\-authorized AI capabilities within the work environment to support technology risk and controls workflows with strong validation habits and awareness of data sensitivity.
* Ability to review and validate AI\-assisted risk summaries and recommendations before use, escalating when uncertain and ensuring outcomes align to security, auditability, and regulatory expectations.




**Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Certification: CISA, CRISC, CISSP, AWS or other security certification preferred

**Data \& Continuous Improvement**
* Monitor product performance metrics post\-launch (e.g., delivery success rates, engagement, adoption).
* Identify opportunities to improve user experience, efficiency, or technical reliability.
* Support documentation, release notes, and internal enablement material for SMS product updates.


**Qualifications**
* 3\-5 years of experience as a Product Owner, Business Analyst, or Technical Product Lead, ideally within CPaaS, telecom, or messaging platforms.
* Strong familiarity with SMS, or other messaging APIs.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments, with hands\-on backlog and sprint management.
* Excellent ability to translate complex requirements into clear, testable user stories.
* Solid communication and collaboration skills across technical and business teams.
* Analytical mindset with a focus on product quality, delivery, and customer impact.

* Experience collaborating with mobile operators, OEMs, or messaging aggregators.

* The SMS product backlog is always clear, prioritized, and ready for execution.

* High\-quality, timely releases that drive adoption and customer satisfaction.

Candescent is a forward\-thinking technology company transforming how financial institutions deliver Intelligent Banking experiences. We unite digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions that power and connect digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions—creating seamless engagement across digital, remote, and in\-person channels.
   

  

 Our Experience\-Led, Intelligence\-Driven approach combines human\-centered design with data, automation, and cloud\-based innovation. Built on an API\-first architecture, our extensible ecosystem enables institutions to adapt quickly, integrate easily, and unlock new opportunities for growth—turning every customer interaction into a moment of clarity, confidence, and connection.
   

  

**About Candescent**
 Candescent is the leading cloud\-based digital banking solutions provider for financial institutions. We are transforming digital banking with intelligent, cloud\-powered solutions that connect account opening, digital banking, and branch experiences for financial institutions. Our advanced technology and developer tools enable seamless, differentiated customer journeys that elevate trust, service, and innovation. Success here requires flexibility in a fast\-paced environment, a client\-first mindset, and a commitment to delivering consistent, reliable results as part of a performance\-driven, values\-led team. With team members around the world, Candescent is an equal opportunity employer.
   

  

**PRODUCT OWNER \- Consumer**
**Position Summary**
 We are seeking experienced Product Owners to help deliver on our product objectives and roadmaps. Product Owners are responsible for delivering product outcomes and functionality that meet customer and user needs. They translate product vision and insights into prioritized features and user stories, developed by their agile team of 8–10 members.
   

  

 This role collaborates with Candescent clients and Product Managers to identify and prioritize requirements for enhancements to the Banking Platform. Product Owners also work with the Product Advisory Council, participating in user group discussions and presenting both strategic and tactical functionality. **Customer Experience Research, Insights, And Execution**
* Demonstrate a deep understanding of customers and users through the development of insights, including personas, journey maps, and product charters


**Product Design and Development**

Job Purpose and Impact
   

  

 Sr. Digital Product Lead will be responsible for the ownership of products or platforms for the organization. In this role, you will own the business strategy behind a product, establish a vision for the product and discover problems, opportunities and solutions. You will coordinate work done by many other functions connected to Supply Chain Planning and are ultimately responsible for the business success of the product. You will partner with cross functional teams, analyze markets and define objectives and key results.
   

  

 Key Accountabilities
   

  

* Own Ai\-Forecasting product strategy and solution, from discovery to delivery and identify business value and end user outcomes including key performance indicators and financial return on investment.
* Maintain prioritization and refinement of the product backlog, deciding what to build and when, partnering with agile teams to estimate features, define requirements and collaborate on a product roadmap based on the team’s capacity.
* Serve as product functional owner bringing new products to market by analyzing proposed product requirements and product development programs, preparing return on investment analyses and addressing product team questions.
* Analyze market and competitive conditions to strike a clear path towards the business value of the product and make that clear to the team that serves the customer.
* Analyze and addresses the critical product risks including value, usability, feasibility and business viability.
* Contribute to analysis, research, design, implementation of new features and KPI driven forecasting methodologies.
* Use quantitative and qualitative data for thorough analysis to identify predictive \& prescriptive forecasting model and prioritize on what to build or optimize.
* Independently handle complex issues with minimal supervision, while escalating only the most complex issues to appropriate staff.
* Other duties as assigned


**Qualifications**
 MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
   

  

* Bachelor's degree in a Engineering, MBA in Business Analytics, Math related field or equivalent experience
* Strong experience in Supply Chain Planning, working with forecasting models, regression analysis, time series, probabilistic models, supervised classification and unsupervised learning.
* Product management or product development experience
* Experience facilitating teams and breaking down business requirements into deliverables
* Minimum of four years of related work experience
* Other minimum qualifications may apply


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Agile, Scrum, Product Owner certifications
* Experience with timeseries forecasting such as ARIMA, Prophet, DeepAR, etc
* Product or project management certification
* Experience leading change and communication with a large and diverse group of stakeholders
* Clear understanding of agile values, frameworks and metrics

 Kobie, a 35\-year veteran of the loyalty industry, a multi\-year Forrester Leader, and USA Top Workplace is expanding its global footprint by establishing a Tech Hub in India. Kobie partners with global brands to build deep connections with their customers through personalized, data\-driven loyalty experiences and has a mission of growing enterprise value through loyalty. The Tech Hub will serve as a Global Capabilities Center for a broad range of technology roles, and this is your chance to play a pivotal role in shaping our presence in India. Join us as we continue to lead in loyalty, delivering innovative customer experiences for some of the world’s most recognized brands while working alongside some of the best and brightest in loyalty.
   

  

**About The Team And What We’ll Build Together**
 The Product Owner team makes Kobie's strategic product vision a reality through the development of technology solutions. We drive projects forward, collaborating with development teams and stakeholders to deliver unparalleled personalized experiences to customers worldwide. We are quick on our feet, using critical thinking and creative problem solving to optimize the value of products released. We champion platform standards to achieve long\-lasting, quality outcomes that help our clients grow enterprise value through loyalty.

* Lead design and execution of roadmap enhancements to Kobie Alchemy® Loyalty Cloud, owning the business logic and platform rules that drive loyalty program outcomes for enterprise clients.

 Giving back is in our DNA at Kobie,through an annual fundraiser, charitable partnerships, and volunteer opportunities, we encourage our teammates to make a difference in their communities.
   

  

 To support our teammates beyond just their careers, we offer highly competitive benefits, comprehensive health coverage, and well\-being perks that support our teammates and their dependents. We understand the importance of time for life outside of work \- recognizing public holidays,offering flexible time off, and prioritizing work\-life balance.

With continued growth, we will establish a physical office in Bengaluru, India, giving teammates aspace for collaboration and fostering connection.

Reporting to the Director of Product Management, you will manage the product backlog, prioritize features, and collaborate with engineering, and stakeholders to deliver seamless integrations that support Flexera’s strategic goals.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Flexera is seeking a technically strong Product Owner to drive the strategy and execution of our APIs, integrations, and platform automation capabilities. You will own the product backlog for API\-driven features and cross\-cloud integrations, working closely with engineering, architecture, and design teams to deliver scalable, secure, and connector\-rich platform experiences.

* Own and prioritize the product backlog across platform capabilities, translating business needs into clear user stories and acceptance criteria.
* Define technical requirements, including interfaces and data contracts, partnering with engineering on feasibility.
* Drive the roadmap for platform integrations enabling data flow between internal systems and external platforms.
* Lead requirements for automation and notification capabilities, including automated workflows and approval processes.
* Collaborate with architects on system design trade\-offs and constraints.
* Define identity, access, and authorization requirements across the platform.
* Act as the primary liaison between stakeholders and the development team within an Agile framework.

* Proficiency in Python and SQL for data manipulation, pipeline development, and analytical scripting.
* Experience building dashboards and reports in Power BI or an equivalent tool (Tableau, Looker, etc).
* Familiarity with medallion architecture patterns and data lakehouse concepts.
* Working knowledge of ETL/ELT pipeline development and data quality management.
* Experience with workflow automation tools (Power Automate, Databricks Workflows, Apache Airflow, or similar).

* Experience working in agile/sprint\-based delivery environments as well as traditional project management frameworks.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate technical concepts for non\-technical audiences and work effectively with global, cross\-functional teams.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
============================

* General familiarity with AI/ML concepts, tooling, and practical applications in a business context (e.g., Databricks MLflow, cloud AI services, context management, prompt engineering, or RAG architectures).
* APICS/ASCM certification (CPIM, CSCP, or CTSC) or actively pursuing.

jobs.title: Asst. Business Analyst , Now LM
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Amazon Now is one of India's fastest\-growing quick commerce platforms, and our Last Mile (LM) network is the engine that powers every delivery. We are looking for a curious, detail\-oriented Assistant Business Analyst to join the Amazon Now LM team, to build the data insight and reporting backbone that will drive cost and performance decisions across our 1P and 3P last mile channels.  

  

In this role, you will own data aggregation, reporting, and insight generation across key LM metrics — including cost per delivery (CPD), rate cards, payout structures, and Delivery Partner performance indicators such as orders delivered, service hours, and distance traveled. You will work at the intersection of data and operations, turning raw numbers into clear, actionable insights that shape how we manage our delivery partner network and control costs.  

  

This is an ideal role for someone who is intellectually curious about quick commerce and data science, has a strong instinct to simplify complex data problems, and thrives on delivering results through data\-driven insights.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

LM Cost Reporting: Own end\-to\-end team\-level reporting on cost per delivery (CPD) across 1P and 3P last mile channels — tracking actuals vs. targets, identifying cost drivers, and flagging anomalies for review. Prepare and publish regular performance reports for LM operations, finance, and 3P partner management teams. Translate complex data into clear narratives for non\-technical stakeholders.  

  

Rate Card \& Payout Tracking: Maintain and update store\-level rate card and payout data across the network. Ensure accuracy of payout computations and flag discrepancies between contracted rates and actuals.  

  

DP Performance Metrics: Build and maintain dashboards tracking delivery partner (DP) level performance — including orders delivered, service hours logged, distance travelled, and productivity indices — across both 1P and 3P channels.  

  

Data Aggregation \& Pipeline Management: Aggregate data from multiple internal and external sources using SQL, S3\-based data pipelines, and Excel (including Macros) to create clean, reliable datasets that power weekly, monthly, and ad hoc reporting.
  

  

JSON Data Management: Leverage JSON to parse, manage, and transform complex nested data structures — particularly for 3P partner data feeds, API outputs, and pipeline payloads — ensuring data is accurately flattened and integrated into reporting workflows.  

  

A day in the life  

Your day starts with a check on overnight data pipelines — validating that CPD and DP performance dashboards have refreshed correctly, including 3P data feeds ingested via S3\. You spend the morning writing SQL queries to pull the latest payout data, parsing JSON outputs from a 3P partner pipeline, and cross\-checking actuals against rate cards. By midday, you're refining an Excel Macro to automate a weekly cost summary. The afternoon brings a sync with the LM ops team — you come prepared with clean visuals and a clear point of view. You close the day updating dashboards and queuing up the next reporting pack.  

  

About the team  

The Amazon Now Last Mile team is responsible for building and operating one of India's fastest\-growing quick commerce delivery networks. We obsess over speed, reliability, and cost — and we do it at scale, across hundreds of dark stores and millions of deliveries every month.  

  

Our LM Pricing team sits at the core of this engine. We define how delivery partners are compensated, how capacity is planned and flexed, and how the network responds to demand volatility. We are a small, high\-ownership team that values intellectual curiosity, operational rigor, and a bias for simplification. If you love turning messy data into clean insights — and want your work to directly shape how millions of customers receive their orders — this is the team for you.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 1\+ years of data analytics or automation experience
* 1\+ years of capacity planning, operations planning, business analysis or similar experience
* Bachelor's degree
* Knowledge of data pipelining and extraction using SQL
* Knowledge of SQL and Excel at a moderate or advanced level
* Experience with data mining tools like SQL, SAS, SPSS, or similar

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Knowledge of SQL/Python/R, scripting, MS Excel, table joins, and aggregate analytical functions
